labelTraps.label: contested (legitimacy band)
labelTraps.engineMeaning: a legitimacy score below 0.25: `if (v >= 0.25) return { label: 'tenuous' … }; return { label: 'contested', tone: 'bad' };` — the claim is broadly rejected; nobody need be contesting it

labelTraps.label: contested (the field flag)
labelTraps.engineMeaning: `const contested = active.length > 1 && (patronShare - topRival) < RELIGION_TUNING.PATRON_FLIP_MARGIN;` — a rival within six share points; nothing to do with legitimacy

labelTraps.label: contested (occupation rung)
labelTraps.field: occupations[id].state, read via settlementOccupation into occupationPaysPoolKey
labelTraps.engineMeaning: `contested: 'a contested occupation; the occupier has not yet taken hold'` — the LOWEST rung of the ladder, STATE_BENEFIT_SCALE 0.0

labelTraps.label: CONTESTED (DS-FTH-4 pool key)
labelTraps.field: the block's own total resolution order
labelTraps.engineMeaning: 'a rival niche occupied, OR legitimacy in its low band' — a DISJUNCTION of two of the three senses above

labelTraps.label: established (legitimacy band)
labelTraps.engineMeaning: `if (v >= 0.5) return { label: 'established', tone: 'gold' }` — a legitimacy in [0.5, 0.75)

labelTraps.label: established (creed standing)
labelTraps.engineMeaning: `share >= E` where `STANDING_ESTABLISHED: 15` — an adherent share of 15 percent; an entirely different quantity from the legitimacy band of the same name

labelTraps.label: cult (creed standing)
labelTraps.engineMeaning: the residue below established (share under 15) AND the value forcibly written onto a SUPPRESSED creed: `const rec = { ...state.deities[ref], suppressed: true, share: 0, standing: 'cult' };`

labelTraps.label: cult (rankAxis / pantheon tier)
labelTraps.engineMeaning: a realm-wide SEAT COUNT below MINOR_PROMOTE = 2; it says nothing about this town

labelTraps.label: cults[]
labelTraps.field: faith.cults, read by the CULTS lens
labelTraps.engineMeaning: config.cultDeitySnapshots — every non-patron embedded deity regardless of standing or rank; a Major deity sitting as a non-patron is in cults[]

labelTraps.label: at peace
labelTraps.engineMeaning: `return POSTURE_PHRASE[String(state)] || 'at peace';` — an UNKNOWN posture token also reads 'at peace'; a totalizing fallback wearing a reading's clothes

labelTraps.label: contested (occupation default arm)
labelTraps.engineMeaning: `return STATE_PHRASE[String(state)] || STATE_PHRASE.contested;` — an unknown state reads as contested

labelTraps.label: honored
labelTraps.engineMeaning: `normalizeState`: anything not 'defaulted' and not 'strained', including absent and unrecognised, becomes 'honored'

labelTraps.label: atWar
labelTraps.engineMeaning: a constant `true` whenever the object exists, and `null` (not `false`) otherwise: `if (!besiegingTargets.length && !besiegedBy.length) return null; return { …, atWar: true };` — it carries no information beyond object non-nullity

labelTraps.label: At war (the pool key)
labelTraps.engineMeaning: the RESIDUE arm — 'a war scar, a ramp or a holding with no front anywhere' — not a declared state of war

labelTraps.label: victorId / loserId
labelTraps.engineMeaning: victorId is receiverId and loserId is giverId, 'on a WR-10 sale exactly as on a war settlement' — so on a sale the victor is the BUYER and the loser is the SELLER

labelTraps.label: burdened
labelTraps.engineMeaning: `burdened: !pays || resistance >= 0.35` — not the complement of pays; a paying occupation with resistance at or above 0.35 is both paying and burdened

labelTraps.label: largely quiescent
labelTraps.engineMeaning: the floor:0 band, i.e. [0, 0.2) — not zero resistance

labelTraps.label: war_exhaustion
labelTraps.field: three distinct records share the word
labelTraps.engineMeaning: a POSTURE state ('war-weary, its army spent'), a CONDITION archetype (label 'War exhaustion'), and a 0..1 SCAR ledger on worldState.warExhaustion

labelTraps.label: rested
labelTraps.engineMeaning: `if (v <= 0) return 'rested';` — exactly zero scar, a state a DECAYED scar reaches; it does not mean the town never fought

labelTraps.label: hasChurch
labelTraps.engineMeaning: `hasAny(names, ['church','cathedral','temple','monastery','friary','shrine','priest','abbey'])` — a substring match over institution NAMES, true for a resident priest or a wayside shrine with no church building

labelTraps.label: the mandate (null return)
labelTraps.engineMeaning: returns null for a government whose mandateGovWeight is at or below zero — 'a merchant council or a republic, which have no divine mandate to prop'; null is REFUSED-TO-READ, not 'no mandate'

labelTraps.label: Even-handed
labelTraps.engineMeaning: the fall-through arm covering [0.96, 1.04] including exactly 1.0; the exported chip reader returns null for the same range and spells two neighbouring bands differently (Aggressive, Pacifist)

labelTraps.label: plagued
labelTraps.field: config.monsterThreat (cross-desk, named by the chair; confirmed in this dock)
labelTraps.engineMeaning: `if (threat === 'plagued') monster += 8;` under the header '── Monster score ──' — plagued by MONSTER activity, never disease

labelTraps.label: occupation authority
labelTraps.engineMeaning: `item?.settlement?.powerStructure?.governingName || …government || 'occupation authority'` — a literal fallback string that will render as if it were a name

labelTraps.label: ticksToDeploy
labelTraps.engineMeaning: 'Heuristic, presentation-only (the real rate is disposition-gated; this is the optimistic ~N ticks the DM sees). A war-ready / non-ramp posture returns 0.'

labelTraps.label: shortage (flow band)
labelTraps.engineMeaning: LOW MEASURED ROAD THROUGHPUT this tick: inflow + outflow < STRAIN_FLOOR, and only on a trade-dependent town. Not a shortage of goods.

labelTraps.label: surplus (flow band)
labelTraps.engineMeaning: Throughput ABOVE a ceiling. Not goods piling up.

labelTraps.label: strained / met / abundant
labelTraps.engineMeaning: A RE-LABELLING OF THE BAND, 1:1 - not a second measurement.

labelTraps.label: trade-dependent
labelTraps.engineMeaning: The town has ANY import, export, tradeDependency or tradeLink recorded. A one-export, self-feeding town counts as trade-dependent.

labelTraps.label: vulnerable (export posture)
labelTraps.engineMeaning: access === 'isolated'. Not raiders, not war, not a cut route.

labelTraps.label: entrepot / isEntrepot
labelTraps.engineMeaning: route === 'crossroads', or a port with an institution named 'international trade' or 'warehouse district'. Not measured transit.

labelTraps.label: import_dependent
labelTraps.engineMeaning: A LABEL WITH NO PRODUCER - the status ladder has five arms and never sets it.

labelTraps.label: dear / cheap
labelTraps.engineMeaning: A STOCK COUNT against a fixed target of 8 units, with no demand term and no coin anywhere in the model.

labelTraps.label: impaired (service)

labelTraps.label: Stable (coup risk)
labelTraps.engineMeaning: no NON-GOVERNING, NON-CRIMINAL faction with power >= 5. It does not mean nobody wants the seat: criminal factions are excluded from the coup field by construction because 'the capture ladder is their path'.

labelTraps.label: weight / 'outweighs'
labelTraps.engineMeaning: power x COUP_COERCION[archetype] — a coercion coefficient, so a military house of 20 power outweighs a merchant house of 25.

labelTraps.label: gated
labelTraps.engineMeaning: 'the ruler only presents a case if it re-enters the top 3 post-amplification'; with fewer than three challengers it is ALWAYS true by construction, because the pool is the top 3 by definition.

labelTraps.label: mixed (ruling power)
labelTraps.engineMeaning: the FAIL-SOFT default of rulingPowerFromArchetype, returned for every category the mapping table does not carry — magic, economy and other. It is not a measured reading of a blended government.

labelTraps.label: mixed (economic base)
labelTraps.engineMeaning: likewise fail-soft, and the ONLY value the shipped lens can ever produce, because structuralLensOf passes no economicBase at all and the three source keys have no writer.

labelTraps.label: legitimacyNerve (coup / unrest / heresy / insolvency / betrayal)
labelTraps.engineMeaning: a CONSTANT of the lens table, one per ruling power. It is a disposition of the KIND of seat, never a reading of this town, and never an assertion that the feared thing is happening.

labelTraps.label: hysteresisWiden
labelTraps.engineMeaning: a multiplier on the verdict deadband and dwell (council 1.4; everything else 1.0-1.1). Only its consequence may be spoken — a council's decisions are slow and stick; an autocrat's are fast and swing.

labelTraps.label: consolidation = 0
labelTraps.engineMeaning: returned for BOTH a dormant layer and a live layer with no ruling bloc, and also whenever totalPower <= 0. It is not a measured 'fully divided court'.

labelTraps.engineMeaning: derived from the POOL-KEY STRING alone and licensed as the one place a label may be read: 'the pool key string is never the PREDICATE… this column reads the key and nothing else reads the key'. It is never evidence about the town.

labelTraps.label: present: false
labelTraps.engineMeaning: no legitimacy record at all (a legacy save or an ungenerated settlement); the ledger still returns legitimacyScore 50, which is a NEUTRAL DEFAULT and not a reading.

labelTraps.label: deferred (receipt kind)
labelTraps.engineMeaning: THREE different situations share the one word: the formation draw missed, the leaders' rivalry blocked an aligned pair, or the settlement is at the three-bloc cap.

labelTraps.engineMeaning: score >= 45 and < 60 — 'no edge either way'. It is the NEUTRAL middle of a 0..100 scale, not a statement that the town endures its rulers grudgingly.

The card's printed `may NOT` line is a fixed six-term refusal (a count, a cause, a season, a future, a standpoint, a second fact) plus a civic-object term: it already refuses the owner's "typically has" categories, but it has NO column at all for what the noun MEANS by definition. That gap is what this packet inventories.

labelTraps.engineMeaning: `event.type = cat` stamps the CATEGORY, and three categories are one-to-one with a differently-named fine event: exile_return: ['occupation_legacy'] → the row is named 'The Occupation'; occupation_infiltration: ['infiltration_fear'] → 'The Purge'; demographic: ['population_friction'] → 'The Migration'. `disaster` includes external_threat → 'The Siege', which is not a natural disaster.

labelTraps.label: viable
labelTraps.engineMeaning: `const isViable = criticalIssues.length === 0;` — 'no CRITICAL coherence issue at the first survey'. Not self-sufficiency, not survival, not prosperity. The page's own headline word is COHERENT and the page says the check is never re-run.

labelTraps.label: forest / plains (terrain)
labelTraps.engineMeaning: Derived from the route when no override is set: isolated → 'forest', road → 'plains', crossroads → 'plains'. WOODLAND and OPEN-GROUND are therefore route DEFAULTS on most towns, not observations of the land.

labelTraps.engineMeaning: Substring name matches, not category reads. hasPrison includes `stocks`; hasCourtSystem includes `city hall`, `town hall`, `democratic assembly`; hasHospital includes `monastery`, `healer`, `friary`; hasChurch includes `temple`, `shrine`, `priest`, `abbey`, `monastery`; hasNavy includes `major port`; hasPort is /\b(?:port|docks?|harbou?r|shipyard|navy)\b/ so a shipyard sets it.

labelTraps.engineMeaning: `id: 'clock.bread_riot.<trigger>'` versus `label: 'Bread Riot Clock'`. The leaf calls this its standing label trap: 'The id carries the producer's token and the label carries a display string, and only one of those is a join key.'

labelTraps.label: LEVEL
labelTraps.engineMeaning: Band 0 is also the NO-DATA answer: `if (pops.length < 2) return { band: 0, net: 0, window: pops.length };`. labelTraps.label: Secure (food) versus Secure (safety)
labelTraps.engineMeaning: Two unrelated ladders share one word on one block. Food `Secure` is the ELSE-ARM of the deficit/surplus cascade (deficitPct ≤ 5 and surplusPct ≤ 40); safety `Secure` is a corpus word the safety producer never writes at all.

labelTraps.label: severity

Variant 6 (annex :4164) asserts altars, stonework and a visible age off a bare token.

rows.nameClass: generator `slave_revolt` (requiresTier 'town') + world `slave_revolt` DEPRECATED + world `rebellion` origin variant `servile_uprising`
entails: GENERATOR RECORD ONLY: an enslaved population has organised; the slave market's commercial operations are suspended; labour-dependent production is disrupted (stressTypes.js:144-145, stressNarrative.js:135-141)
the settlement is town-tier or larger (stressTypes.js:141; gate at stressGenerator.js:343)
notEntailed: that the settlement was BUILT on bound labour - the only economic coupling is a probability tilt off two priority sliders (economy > 55 && criminal > 50 -> x2.0, else x0.4, stressGenerator.js:251-255)
engineContradicts: Variant 1's 'the settlement was built on its reliability' (annex :4167) is a structural-history claim the sliders do not carry.

The world layer denies the substrate outright: slave_revolt is deprecated 'Folded out of ORGANIC births only (the sim has no slavery substrate to make the claim honestly - organic uprisings birth as `rebellion`, with a `servile_uprising` variant when the labor context fits)' (stressorsCore.js:176-182). The same English words are licensed at DS-STR-1 and refused at DS-STR-2 ORIGIN: servile_uprising.

rows.nameClass: generator `wartime` + world `wartime` ('Wartime footing', durationPolicy 'structural')
entails: the settlement is inside a kingdom at war
military expenditure dominates the economy (stressTypes.js:155-156)
affectedSystems defense_readiness, tax_revenue, labor_capacity
engineContradicts: THE HIDDEN COIN, and the sharpest row on the desk. `wartime` is the ONLY stress type that draws rng, and the coin is profit/loss: rollStressSummary returns { profit: rng() < 0.45 } (stressNarrative.js:40-42). The profit branch reads 'currently positioned to profit. Military contracts are flowing. The garrison is reinforced and well-supplied ... merchants with the right connections are getting richer' (stressNarrative.js:143-152, text at :147). 45% of wartime towns are profiting; conscription appears ONLY in the loss branch. Corpus variants 4 and 6 assert scarcity as fact - 'the men, the carts, and the ordinary expectation of next year', '{settlement} is short of the kind of people a town this size should be full of' (annex :4178, :4180).

rows.nameClass: generator `mass_migration` + world `mass_migration` + condition archetype `regional_migration_pressure`
entails: a population movement of a scale the settlement's infrastructure was not built for
notEntailed: INFLOW - the direction is not fixed by the type: the viabilityNote names both faces, 'Immigration: food balance stressed ... Emigration: tax base shrinking, institutions hollowing, labour shortage emerging' (stressTypes.js:166-167)
that the newcomers came from somewhere worse
engineContradicts: All six corpus variants assert ARRIVALS (annex :4183, :4185, :4187). Only the renderer is inflow-shaped (stressNarrative.js:158-164, text at :162); the record's own viabilityNote holds both directions. Variant 5's {band} is RESERVED and never fills so it is silent; the other five speak. Variant 1 also asserts a wall.

rows.nameClass: STRESSOR_LIFECYCLE_STAGES, seven members, five written by the corpus
entails: EXACTLY the derivation: peaking <= severity >= 0.72; easing <= severity <= 0.24 && age > 0; emerging <= age <= 1; active otherwise; resolved/residual/dormant <= status says so (stressorsCore.js:314-322)
residual IS an echo, minted by echoOf with memoryStrength decaying on a ~6-tick half-life (stressorsCore.js:362-368, :468-500)
engineContradicts: `peaking` variant 2 - 'The strain has stopped compounding and started simply holding' (annex :4240). The model has no compounding-stopped state; peaking is a severity threshold and severity may still be climbing.
`emerging` variant 2 attributes a standpoint to 'the people worst placed for it'; emerging means age <= 1, nothing more.
`easing` variant 1 - 'the town ... has begun to plan past the trouble' (annex :4244); easing means low severity, not any town action.

rows.nameClass: VARIANT_HOOKS, 17 members, each bound by the interpreter to specific stressor types
entails: the type binding only: foreign_sponsored/abandoned_agent/internal_conspiracy <- betrayal (:742-773); declared_war/unattributed <- siege|wartime|occupation (:775-799); resistance <- insurgency under an ACTIVE occupation (:802-816); servile_uprising/tax_revolt/popular_revolt <- rebellion (:818-846); arcane_burnout/leyline_silence <- magic_deadzone (:850-873); the six coup variants <- coup_detat by leading challenger archetype (:875-919)
unattributed entails that the record HOLDS NO ATTACKER: 'The attacker is unnamed until the DM says otherwise' (:797)
notEntailed: the current state of the gating condition
walls, halls, warehouses, courthouses, pulpits or workrooms
engineContradicts: EVERY origin variant is a BIRTH-TIME stamp and is never re-interpreted: 'Birth-time field snapshot - NARRATIVE only. The verdict recomputes contenders from live state' (stressorDynamics.js:896-898). ORIGIN: resistance variant 3 reads that birth-time occupation in the PRESENT tense (annex :4331).
`unattributed` variant 2, 'knew precisely where the walls are weakest' (annex :4325), asserts walls on a type that fires at any tier.

`servile_uprising` asserts bound labour and manumission papers (annex :4369-4370) off a gate that is two causal scores (labor_capacity < 35 && public_legitimacy < 40, :826-833), in an engine that states it has no slavery substrate (stressorsCore.js:176-178).
merchant_cabal / temple_putsch / council_schism assert a warehouse, a pulpit and sanctuary, and a chamber and seal (annex :4343, :4348, :4358) - the market, temple and hall civic classes.

rows.nameClass: SEVERITY_BANDS, cuts at 0.75 / 0.5 / 0.25
entails: the record's `severity` float sits in that band, and nothing else - the annex says so twice: 'Severity is a float the prose never speaks' (annex :4222, :4402-4403)
notEntailed: what the town has given up
engineContradicts: POLARITY. reconstruction, boom and flourishing are positive-polarity LIFTS 'they RAISE the systems they declare' (archetypeCatalog.js:31; templates activeConditions.js:467, :475, :483). Severity on them is a magnitude, not a strain. SEVERITY: critical renders 'The town is at its limit. There is no capacity left to absorb this' (annex :4425) - false of a boom. The desk fires all five condition lenses on the SAME record (stressorsStateProse.js:479-486).

THE DEFAULT. An unknown archetype has no template, so severity defaults to 0.25 (activeConditions.js:626-628) -> band 'medium' -> the desk prints 'The pressure is genuine now' off a fallback constant.

WHICH CONDITION. The desk describes conditions[0] (stressorsStateProse.js:462, docblock :445-448) and deriveAllActiveConditions does no sorting (activeConditions.js:680-684), so 'one of the defining facts about the town' may describe whichever record is first in the array.

rows.nameClass: VALID_STATUSES; drift worsening +0.04/tick, easing -0.06/tick, all else 0
entails: the record carries that direction word and the aging pass will drift severity accordingly
engineContradicts: THE E-3 PROTECTION IS DEFEATED AT THE CALL SITE. The annex's rule is 'a condition whose input status is missing, legacy or active holds FLAT' (annex :4397-4401) and the desk's key function honours it (stressorsStateProse.js:201-214). But OverviewTab hands the desk deriveAllActiveConditions(r) (OverviewTab.jsx:186), and deriveActiveCondition substitutes the archetype's defaultStatus first: `const status = VALID_STATUSES.has(condition.status) ? condition.status : (tmpl ? tmpl.defaultStatus : 'stable')` (activeConditions.js:644-646). A statusless plague routes to DIRECTION: worsening.

THE ENGINE NAMES THIS EXACT HAZARD AND REFUSES IT ON ITS OWN PATH: '[domain-top-state-1] Preserve the RAW status when the input had no valid directional status. Writing back canonical.status would canonicalize a missing/legacy/active status to the template default (e.g. plague's worsening), and the next tick would read that written-back direction and invent motion (+0.04/tick) - defeating the drift's own no-invented-motion invariant' (activeConditions.js:894-901; same at :835-840).

BIRTH. Every condition the desk measured sat at elapsedTicks: 0 (stressorsStateProse.js:329-331); 'each season costs a little more than the one before' (annex :4430) asserts a history that has not happened.

WIND-DOWN OVERRIDE. Within 2 ticks of expiry the status is forced to 'easing' and persisted regardless of the real direction (EXPIRY_EASING_WINDOW_TICKS = 2, activeConditions.js:859, applied :879-882, written :902). DIRECTION: easing variant 3 (annex :4442) attributes repair spending to a clock.

POLARITY. reconstruction defaults to easing (:472) -> 'It is lifting' about a rebuild; boom and flourishing default to stable (:480, :488) -> the FLAT pool's 'Nothing here is moving. That is not relief' (annex :4437) about a golden age.

rows.nameClass: the two DS-CND-1 PROVENANCE pools
entails: the record carries at least one cause entry, or a sourceEventType string
notEntailed: that the cause is an IN-WORLD event
engineContradicts: At generation EVERY promoted condition is stamped triggeredAt.sourceEventType: 'GENERATION' and causes: [{ source: 'generation', detail: 'Settlement generated under stressor "<label>".' }] (conditionPromotion.js:203-208). So the key function routes 100% of birth conditions to the TRACED pool - the desk measured 14 of 14 (stressorsStateProse.js:326-329). The traced pool says 'The condition traces back to {reason}, and the trace is not disputed. The town knows exactly what did this.' (annex :4460). The trace is a bookkeeping sentinel meaning 'this world was born this way'.

Mitigated ONLY because all three variants name {reason} and {reason} never fills, so the pool is held silent by anchored liveness (stressorsStateProse.js:277-291). Ruling a {reason} fill vocabulary lights a false sentence.

rows.nameClass: DS-CND-1 DURATION pool
entails: expiresAtTicks - elapsedTicks <= 0.25 * expiresAtTicks - the desk's own cut, declared vetoable: 'there was no canonical cut to reuse and inventing one silently would have been the worse move. Say veto to move it'
engineContradicts: The engine's OWN wind-down is a FIXED 2 ticks, not a fraction (activeConditions.js:859). The two disagree in both directions: war_exhaustion (expiresAtTicks 18, :358) fires the desk pool 4.5 ticks out while the engine has not begun easing; war_spoils (5, :459) fires at 1.25 ticks, inside the engine's window. 'It is nearly over' is a desk constant, not a record fact.

rows.noun: archetype (reconstruction / boom / flourishing - the three written of 46)
rows.nameClass: CONDITION_ARCHETYPE_TEMPLATES, 46 rows; UPSWING_LIFT_CONDITIONS, 3
entails: reconstruction: 'rebuilding after a calamity or the lifting of a siege' (activeConditions.js:469)
boom: 'Sustained trade and surplus ... Prosperous, and quietly dependent on the arteries feeding it' (:477)
flourishing: 'A long peace and steady legitimacy ... a golden age, modest and bounded' (:485)
notEntailed: that the upswing arcs are enabled in this world at all
engineContradicts: 'Minted by the lazy upswingKernel mover, gated behind virtual upswingArcsEnabled; a dark world never carries them' (activeConditions.js:463-466). The three pools are unreachable in a world with the arcs off - a reachability fact to hold beside the desk's 'three of 46' note (stressorsStateProse.js:216-222).

rows.noun: the ARITY pool (several banners standing at once)
rows.nameClass: DS-STR-1 arity pool, keyed on banners.length > 1
entails: banners.length > 1
notEntailed: that either makes the other harder to end
engineContradicts: At generation the cap is EXACTLY TWO: 'Second stress: only fires ~10% of the time when a primary exists', sorted.slice(0, 2) (stressGenerator.js:353-356). 'Several' is always two at birth.

Both variants assert interaction - 'they are not independent. Each makes the others harder to end', 'the troubles here compound, and the compounding is the real condition' (annex :4191-4192). The generator's two stresses are drawn by INDEPENDENT rolls (stressGenerator.js:340-346) with no interaction model at all; the compounding model (STRESSOR_SYNERGIES, stressorDynamics.js:466-523) lives on the WORLD record, a different array. Compounding asserted from an arity count is a cause, and the licence card refuses 'a cause'.

labelTraps.label: plagued
labelTraps.engineMeaning: 'The surrounding region is plagued by MONSTER activity.' Not disease. On this desk it multiplies under_siege and monster_pressure by 2.5 and wartime by 1.3; it never touches plague_onset, whose block reads religion, healer, route and magic only.
labelTraps.source: src/components/new/SummaryTab.jsx:37; src/generators/stressGenerator.js:119 and :230; the plague_onset block that never reads it, :172-180

labelTraps.label: plague_onset
labelTraps.engineMeaning: the ONSET of a disease outbreak, explicitly not yet a plague: 'It is not yet a plague, but it will be if nothing changes.' The label is 'Disease Outbreak'.

labelTraps.label: plague
labelTraps.engineMeaning: the archetype any /plague|disease|pox|fever|outbreak|pestilence/i match promotes to - the same English word as the stress type above, but a different record class with its own 12-tick clock and its own worsening default.

labelTraps.label: monster_pressure / 'Beast & Raider Threat'
labelTraps.engineMeaning: not monsters: 'Whether wolves, raiders, or worse.' The world twin is named monster_raider_pressure.

labelTraps.label: religious_conversion / 'Religious Conversion'
labelTraps.engineMeaning: three unequal branches selected by name.length % 3 - a faith gaining ground, a FRACTURE with both sides claiming succession, or AN OUTSIDE AUTHORITY REQUIRING conversion. The corpus pool is named 'RELIGIOUS CRISIS'.

labelTraps.label: indebted / 'Indebted to Outside Power'
labelTraps.engineMeaning: the corpus pool is 'INDEBTED TO AN OUTSIDE POWER'; the desk keys on the token so the wording gap costs nothing - and records the mismatch in the table itself.

labelTraps.label: emerging
labelTraps.engineMeaning: age <= 1 tick. Nothing about visibility, deniability, or whether anyone has named it.

labelTraps.label: peaking
labelTraps.engineMeaning: severity >= 0.72 - a threshold, not a turning point. The strain may still be climbing.

labelTraps.label: easing
labelTraps.engineMeaning: severity <= 0.24 && age > 0 - a low LEVEL, not a downward trend.

labelTraps.label: easing
labelTraps.engineMeaning: (a) a declared drift direction worth -0.06 severity per tick; (b) FORCED and persisted within 2 ticks of expiry regardless of the real direction.

labelTraps.label: worsening
labelTraps.engineMeaning: +0.04 severity per tick - and, on the display path, the ARCHETYPE'S DEFAULT substituted whenever the record carries no valid status. The engine refuses that substitution on its own aging path and says why.
labelTraps.source: src/domain/activeConditions.js:846-849; substitution :644-646; the engine's own warning :894-901

labelTraps.label: GENERATION
labelTraps.engineMeaning: 'this settlement was born carrying this' - not an in-world event. It is nonetheless the value that routes the condition into the TRACED-provenance pool, whose prose says 'The town knows exactly what did this.'

labelTraps.label: source: 'generation'
labelTraps.engineMeaning: the same sentinel on the causes array; detail is literally `Settlement generated under stressor "<label>"`.

labelTraps.label: critical
labelTraps.engineMeaning: severity >= 0.75. A DIFFERENT SEVERITY ladder exists for structural validation with members CRITICAL / IMPLAUSIBLE / INEFFICIENCY / DEPENDENCY - same word, unrelated scale.

labelTraps.label: regional_* (13 archetypes)
labelTraps.engineMeaning: NOT necessarily regional in origin: the promotion table sends purely LOCAL stressors there - mass_migration -> regional_migration_pressure, infiltrated -> regional_criminal_pressure, indebted -> regional_tax_revenue_disruption, politically_fractured -> regional_authority_instability, religious_conversion -> regional_religious_pressure. The annex's FAMILY: regional transmission pool says 'The trouble did not begin here.'

labelTraps.label: war_pressure
labelTraps.engineMeaning: the archetype a siege, a blockade, a war, OR a /monster|raider/ match promotes to. A war_pressure condition may carry no war at all.

labelTraps.label: vassal_extraction
labelTraps.engineMeaning: what an OCCUPATION promotes to; the code explains that re-pointing it at war_pressure 'would instead LOSE the extraction face'.

labelTraps.label: dominant_npc_removed
labelTraps.engineMeaning: what a SUCCESSION VOID promotes to - the archetype name asserts a removed NPC that the void record does not carry.

labelTraps.label: faction_challenge
labelTraps.engineMeaning: what a BETRAYAL and a COUP both promote to - one archetype word for two unrelated crises.

labelTraps.label: war_spoils
labelTraps.engineMeaning: a BENEFIT: 'Tribute, levies, and materiel from stabilized occupations sustain the war effort', affectedSystems [], defaultStatus 'easing'. The annex files it under FAMILY: occupation layer, whose prose reads 'Holding this place costs more than it returns.'

labelTraps.label: severity
labelTraps.engineMeaning: the ORIGIN's severity. A spread target's felt severity is a separate stamped map, severityBySettlement, 'stamped at spread time and never re-aged'.

labelTraps.label: memoryStrength
labelTraps.engineMeaning: exists ONLY on echoes (status 'residual'), decaying on a ~6-tick half-life. Null on every live stressor.

labelTraps.label: probability
labelTraps.engineMeaning: a generator DRAW WEIGHT, capped at 0.35 after modifiers - never a likelihood the town would recognise or a frequency of anything.

labelTraps.label: STRESS_SEVERITY_WEIGHT
labelTraps.engineMeaning: 'Higher weight = stress is more NARRATIVELY severe and gets priority in multi-stress resolution' - which crisis becomes primary, not the severity of anything in the town.

labelTraps.label: colour / historyColour
labelTraps.engineMeaning: a hex swatch, and a six-member timeline tint (military / economic / political / disaster / religious / demographic). famine's historyColour is 'economic'; plague_onset's is 'disaster'.

labelTraps.label: icon
labelTraps.engineMeaning: ALWAYS undefined. buildStressEntry reads stressData.icon and no row of STRESS_TYPE_MAP defines an icon - yet the annex's STATE-KEY line names it as a field of the record.

labelTraps.label: 'QUARANTINE ACTIVE'
labelTraps.engineMeaning: a DISPLAY posture word derived per stress type for the Defense tab and the PDF slice - not a record that a quarantine was declared. Siblings: famine -> 'INTERNAL PRESSURE', indebted -> 'UNDER TRIBUTE', religious_conversion -> 'RELIGIOUS UPHEAVAL'.

labelTraps.label: 'Strong walls give besiegers pause.'
labelTraps.field: a stressorGates reason string on the siege gate
labelTraps.engineMeaning: the field is causalScore(entry,'defense_readiness') >= 70 - NO wall is read. These reason strings land on the candidate 'so the dossier can explain why THIS crisis emerged HERE'.

labelTraps.label: 'The granaries hold a real reserve.'
labelTraps.field: a stressorGates reason string on the famine gate
labelTraps.engineMeaning: the field is foodLedger(...).storageMonths >= 2; the sibling institution reason reads a class regex that includes a fishery and a mill.

labelTraps.label: deprecated: true
labelTraps.engineMeaning: organic births are folded out because 'the sim has no slavery substrate to make the claim honestly'; the entry survives only for legacy saves and deliberate DM authoring.

labelTraps.label: blocksResolution
labelTraps.engineMeaning: reserved for HARD causal dependencies only, and suppressed entirely when the companion is an echo.

labelTraps.label: floorsMet: false
labelTraps.engineMeaning: the score is CAPPED AT NEUTRAL (0.5), never penalised: 'partial strength never punishes, it just doesn't accelerate.' And requireAllFloors is true for SIEGE ONLY - for every other type the flag is false by default, so the conjunctive reading the prose gives it is earned by one type of twenty-one.

labelTraps.label: plagued
labelTraps.engineMeaning: plagued by MONSTER activity, never disease: 'The surrounding region is plagued by monster activity.' The corpus family word is 'plagued'; the engine's third tier is 'heartland', which the corpus calls 'settled'.

labelTraps.label: heartland (corpus: settled)
labelTraps.engineMeaning: the producer says 'heartland'; the corpus says 'settled'. The desk keys on the producer token and maps: 'KEY ON THE CANONICAL PRODUCER TOKEN, NEVER ON THE CORPUS WORD, AND ASSERT THE MAP TOTAL IN BOTH DIRECTIONS.'

labelTraps.label: frontier (the DEFAULT)
labelTraps.engineMeaning: normalizeMonsterThreat(undefined) === 'frontier' — 'an ABSENT tier silently becomes the frontier'. A face reading 'frontier' off an unmeasured town is describing a default. The desk refuses it: measuredMonsterFamily requires the raw value present.

labelTraps.label: civilized
labelTraps.engineMeaning: 'normalizeMonsterThreat forwards civilized UNCHANGED even though it is not a canonical tier. A normaliser that passes a non-canonical value through is not normalising.' Raised, not cured.

labelTraps.label: Very Safe
labelTraps.engineMeaning: 'Enforcement is at least 3.5 times the criminal presence. Fortress towns AND OCCUPATIONS sit here.' A ratio, and an occupied town reaches it.

labelTraps.label: any base safety label
labelTraps.engineMeaning: effectiveSafety = max(militaryEffective/criminalEffective, communityOrderBonus, courtOrderFloor). A thorp with no criminal roster gets a flat 1.25 bonus and reads Moderate with ZERO enforcement; a town with a court gets a 1.20 floor. The label is not a measurement of the watch.

labelTraps.label: Controlled — Authoritarian
labelTraps.engineMeaning: 'Residents face little risk from common thieves and considerably more from the authorities themselves. Unofficial disappearances are not discussed openly.' The English word 'Controlled' reads calm.

labelTraps.label: Hospital present
labelTraps.engineMeaning: keywords are hospital, MONASTERY, HEALER, FRIARY. A village's 'Healer (divine, 1st level)' — 'Basic healing spells. A closed wound costs 10 in gold.' — sets it.

labelTraps.label: Clergy care / 'clergy who tend the sick'
labelTraps.engineMeaning: keywords include SHRINE. 'Wayside shrine' desc: 'Simple prayer marker. No resident clergy.' 'Access to parish church' desc: 'Walk 2-5km to village church for services.'

labelTraps.label: Court only / Court + Prison / 'can arrest, try and hold'
labelTraps.engineMeaning: keywords include TOWN HALL and CITY HALL, and both rows are required:true, baseChance:1. Every generated town and city sets the flag from a 'Meeting place and administrative center' / 'Impressive civic building'.

labelTraps.label: Prison only / 'detention'
labelTraps.engineMeaning: keyword STOCKS; the town row is 'Small prison/stocks' — 'Holding cells AND PUBLIC PUNISHMENT'.

labelTraps.label: Naval force
labelTraps.engineMeaning: keywords 'navy' and 'major port' match ZERO shipped catalogue rows. The status is unreachable on a generated world; DS-DEF-6's naval lens can only return 'Port only' or 'Under blockade'.
labelTraps.source: src/generators/priorityHelpers.js:62; measured over all 280 names in src/data/institutionalCatalog.js

labelTraps.label: {reason}
labelTraps.engineMeaning: not a cause phrase but a WHOLE ENGLISH SENTENCE ending in a period: `Defense readiness score: ${led.readinessScore}.`, 'Defensive walls in place.', `${cond.label} taxes defense readiness.` Slotting it into '...has lost to {reason}' would print '...has lost to Defense readiness score: 62.'

labelTraps.label: QUARANTINE ACTIVE
labelTraps.engineMeaning: the stress's own label is 'Disease Outbreak', and its texts say 'a quarantine that is NOT BEING ENFORCED CONSISTENTLY' and 'Travel is being DISCOURAGED'. The corpus cell says 'the gates are held' / 'Nobody comes in and nobody goes out'.

labelTraps.label: MIGRATION SURGE
labelTraps.engineMeaning: the label is 'Mass Migration' and the viabilityNote covers BOTH directions: 'Immigration: food balance stressed... Emigration: tax base shrinking, institutions hollowing'. The corpus cell asserts ARRIVAL only.

labelTraps.label: UNDER TRIBUTE
labelTraps.engineMeaning: the label is 'Indebted to Outside Power' and the model is a CREDITOR: 'The creditor has sent a representative to collect', 'A significant portion of revenue is being extracted by the creditor.' Tribute (a conqueror's due) is not debt service.

labelTraps.label: BEAST PRESSURE
labelTraps.engineMeaning: the label is 'Beast & Raider Threat' and the hook says 'Someone is DIRECTING this (whether a rival lord, a beast of unusual cunning, or something stranger)'. Not only creatures, and not necessarily unthinking.

labelTraps.label: SECURITY COMPROMISED
labelTraps.engineMeaning: the label is 'Recently Betrayed'; the record is 'The betrayal had consequences that are still unfolding. The betrayer may still be here.' The corpus infers WHAT was given away; the engine records a betrayal, not a leak of arrangements.

labelTraps.label: adequate (the live band)
labelTraps.engineMeaning: '50 is the neutral / NO-INFORMATION score and lands in adequate'.

labelTraps.label: unknown (safety severity)
labelTraps.engineMeaning: the LOUD fallback, deliberately not a quiet neutral. The annex says it DRAWS NO PROSE: 'an unclassifiable safety reading is a defect to surface, not a state to narrate.'

labelTraps.label: Granary present
labelTraps.engineMeaning: the keyword is the STEM 'granar', so the flag is about the BUILDING and never the stock. The stock is foodSecurity.storageMonths, a different fact — the civic-object split (store vs storehouse) was made for exactly this.

labelTraps.label: Arcane support
labelTraps.engineMeaning: keywords include alchemist, scroll scribe, enchant. The generator's own status note then fills from magicDef.slice(0,2) names — a DIFFERENT bucket again.

labelTraps.label: economicGates.military ABSENT
labelTraps.engineMeaning: absent means NO PAID STACK TO GATE, not 'fully funded': 'a hamlet with no paid defenses reports no military gate at all'. wallRationalePoolKey guards on typeof === 'number' and so treats absence as not-strained — correct, but a reader must not read absence as x1.0.

labelTraps.label: Under blockade
labelTraps.engineMeaning: written only by the world pulse, never at generation: 'the live blockaded flag is written each pulse and is only set while the naval layer is lit'. economicState.foodSecurity.stockpile is null on every settlement the pipeline builds.

labelTraps.label: 'no reserves, port open' vs 'granary, port'
labelTraps.engineMeaning: the producer's own asymmetry, mirrored on purpose: the reserve branch reads the INSTITUTION flag hasPort; the empty branch reads the CONFIG value tradeRouteAccess === 'port'. Two different questions behind one row.
